text: VERY good app. I have not accessed Brain.fm on my laptop/PC. I had some trouble applying a discount for the subscription, in that there was no place to enter the code & the amount to be charged was not displayed before I had to complete the purchase. For that reason, I was charged more than I had anticipated. To their credit, as soon as I contacted them, they rectified the error. So, customer service, prompt but the issue should not have existed to start. The app itself is VERY useful. I found it has improved all sessions for which I have used it: focus, sleep, relax, etc. I am using it in conjunction with another device, so it is difficult to say which has improved my symptoms of ADHD & PTSD the most. As a part of a management plan for well-being and mental health, I could not recommend it enough. That being said, delivering the sound to your head is a PITA. LOL Head straps with speakers are hot, ear buds don't work for side sleepers, and the pillow with the speakers in it is constantly muffled. Tiny, high-quality speakers mounted to the headboard seem to be the best approach, but I wish this was in the FAQs or something. It has taken me 30 days to perfect the application of the sounds, alone, never mind testing the efficacy! I am hopeful, over time, that they might work with Apollo Neuro to develop specific tracks, or even 'virtual drugs' that might provide a hedonistic effect without side-effects, or tracks to address pain signaling... I see a lot of possibilities! Good work.

text: Awesome! Been using it for a month, so far very useful! Tracking is very important for growth, so this would be very helpful. 2) Could you please add a feature where we could continue the music where we left off last time? For example, in youtube music we can resume the song from last time when we log in. When I accidentally quit the brain.fm app I lose how much time I have left for the session I was in and the track that i was listening to. Also, adding a listening history would help as tracks are not always listed as 'favorite' and we can't even remember which song took me to the 'zone' last time. I don't know if these are too much to ask over all the good work you're already doing, but I hope you would take these into consideration. Thanks!

text:
The service is fantastic! I suffer from distraction problems, occasional 
sleep problems, and I have a synesthetic relationship to music where I hear 
the colors and textures of sounds around me (which can be very 
distracting). When I turn on an atmospheric focus track, I'm immediately 
given a different perspective to my work. The flickering, vibrating 
undercurrents to the soundscape help drive intention and motivation forward 
since the place exists in a state of perpetual forward motion. The 
atmospheric sounds help take me out of my head and into a different 
location where my scattered thoughts don't exist and I can focus on the 
task at hand. I can pause to "look around" the soundscape, but focus snaps 
back into place when I turn my ear to the vibrating undercurrents. I like 
to worldbuild and write, and some of the soundscapes help me get a clearer 
vision of locations and mood. Definitely worth subscribing to! Most likely 
going to buy access to the service in the future once I can muster up a 
lump sum payment.

text: I've genuinely valued being a subscriber to this app. I use it in conjunction with pomodoro timers to focus on being productive at work and also to filter out noise while commuting. The mobile app should sync to the web app for seamless transition between devices. The web app should have a much smaller mini player option so it can be a window open in the corner (or a widget in the app), the guided meditation option could have translated texts pop up instead of the spoken dialogues for global users, the mobile app should have better interaction with the different themes to explore, a playlist option could then be added so you don't have to switch between tracks and can then work out to different timezones in the day, also when napping the track will stop and give you an option to continue playing with a dialogue but if you're asleep or haven't responded the presumption should be to stop,  there should also be an option for you to monitor your own usage so which tracks you listened to the most and for how long, I'd also welcome a "sample" low quality option of 20 secs to share with friends but this is hard.  I want to see if i can hook the app up to specifically play on Bluetooth speakers with the device instead of playback from phone or headset so it becomes environmental ambience in the home workspace and I can then use my phone to take calls where I can lower the volume instead of abruptly cutting it off  I am seriously kicking myself for not getting lifetime membership of this app when it was on offer because I was sceptical of benefits. text: To be completely honest, I was super skeptical when I heard about this. But last year, I started grad school, started a new position at work, bought a house and got married all within the same four months. Need less to say things got pretty stressful and hectic. I fell pretty behind in school and I wasn't feeling rested at all in the mornings even if I slept through the night. I heard about Brain.fm on a podcast and decided to give it a try. The results were almost immediate!  I started off using the focus tracks and noticed that when I was studying or doing things for work, I was retaining information and completing tasks much more efficiently.  I then moved onto the sleep tracks and listened to them over my portable seakers and my wife noticed an improvement in her sleep as well. I've tried the meditation/relaxation tracks with my brother  (who is an even bigger skeptic than I am), and we've both come out of the sessions totally relaxed and refreshed. I do need to be better at setting time aside to do the relaxation sessions more often. I've read the literature on the site and have done quick read ups on other literature about this type of stuff and to be completely honest (again), a part of me still remains a little skeptical that this isn't just some kind of placebo effect. BUT, what I can't  deny is that it works for me. I honestly would not have caught up and survived my first year of grad school had I not started using this.  The new app is fantastic but web app is also great.  Would have loved a black Friday/cyber Monday deal though. My renewal is coming up soon!  Keep an open mind and give it a try!
